newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian August inflation eases to 3.8 pct vs July.
newsitem.headline: Romanian August inflation eases to 3.8 pct vs July.

text.p: Romanian monthly inflation slowed to 3.8 percent in August after soaring to 7.5 percent in July under fuel and energy price hikes, the National Statistics Board (CNS) reported on Monday.
Year-on-year inflation rose to 44.2 percent in August from July's 40.3 percent, while eight-month consumer prices went up 27.0 percent.

The 1996 official forecast for 12-month inflation is 30 percent, up from a previous 20 percent. But local economists see the forecast as ambitious, saying a rate of 45 percent would be more realistic.
